strategies.S0_no_intervention: Run each task at its original preferred start.
strategies.S1_greedy_nominal: Existing deterministic greedy reference, using the nominal tariff.
strategies.S2_milp_nominal: Existing MILP, using the identical nominal tariff as S1.
strategies.S2_milp_forecast: Existing MILP, using a noisy forecast of future realized interval prices.
strategies.oracle_milp_perfect_information: Existing MILP with realized prices, optimizing energy charge plus inconvenience.
strategies.oracle_milp_energy_only: Existing MILP with realized prices and the preference penalty set to zero.

synthetic_assumptions.household_profiles: Generated synthetic profiles; the same 8 profiles are reused across 192 factorial cells and are not independent household observations.
synthetic_assumptions.tariff: Stylized synthetic AUD energy-only TOU schedule; not observed Australian retail prices.
synthetic_assumptions.scheduling_time_information: Nominal time-of-use periods and the price shape are assumed known when planning. S1 and S2_milp_nominal receive identical nominal prices.
synthetic_assumptions.realized_price_noise_sd_aud_per_kwh: 0.025 * tariff_spread_factor; zero-mean sensitivity assumption, not calibrated to observed retail price deviations.
synthetic_assumptions.forecast_error_sd_aud_per_kwh: 0.25 * forecast_error_spread_fraction * tariff_spread_factor; an uncalibrated stress sensitivity, not a validated forecast distribution.
synthetic_assumptions.forecast_generation: Realized synthetic price plus an independent Gaussian forecast-error perturbation.
synthetic_assumptions.price_assumption_rationale: Chosen to expose sensitivity to uncertainty and tariff spread only; not claimed to be representative of Australian retail tariffs or forecast errors.
synthetic_assumptions.appliance_profiles: Fixed power and duration task assumptions in source.
synthetic_assumptions.weighted_objective: realized energy charge AUD + preference_penalty_aud_per_interval times absolute start-time distance in scheduling intervals
synthetic_assumptions.baseline_energy_cost_aud_compatibility: Deprecated alias for non_flexible_baseline_energy_cost_aud; not complete S0.
synthetic_assumptions.s0_reference_energy_cost_aud: Complete realized energy charge at preferred starts.

equity_metric_definitions.software_access: Not measured; technically complete synthetic advisory inputs are a pipeline-eligibility proxy only and do not establish that a person can access or use the software.
equity_metric_definitions.actionability: Technical feasibility/completion only: the schedule is feasible and all mandatory tasks complete. Practical user actionability is not measured.
equity_metric_definitions.benefit: Absolute modeled energy-charge reduction from the same case's S0, in AUD; not a full bill or verified household saving.
equity_metric_definitions.inconvenience: Sum of absolute task start-time displacements from preferred starts, in hours.
equity_metric_definitions.weighted_objective: Realized energy charge plus the configured preference penalty; a model score, not a validated welfare measure.
equity_metric_definitions.group_labels: Only generated scenario categories (flexibility hours and appliance mix) are used; no demographic or socioeconomic groups are inferred.
equity_metric_definitions.der_comparison: Not estimable: source profiles do not encode PV generation, battery storage, or a verified DER-ownership category. EV charging is only a modeled load task.

synthetic_assumptions.equity_grouping: Synthetic flexibility-hours and appliance-mix categories only; no demographic inference or measured DER categories.
